'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Charles Arlandson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Charles Arlandson]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Charles Arlandson / DaBrazen, 2014 Worlds 08/23/14, 2013 form (green).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' DaBrazen
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
